newReleases.name: OpenCode 2.0
newReleases.summary: Open-source, model-agnostic coding agent with native TUI and multi-session support. #2 on Product Hunt's Oct 13 daily leaderboard (313 upvotes when checked).

newReleases.name: Tiden
newReleases.summary: Verifies coding agents built what you asked for by checking changes against requirements and tests. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot.

newReleases.name: Reason
newReleases.summary: Cost-efficient coding agent that writes code, runs tests and opens PRs, from Mac app, terminal, web or Slack.

newReleases.name: Exodus for Google Cloud Run
newReleases.summary: Free tool with an open-source CLI: your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) audits your app, compares current cost vs Cloud Run, and migrates it task by task using 50+ playbooks. #8 on launch day.

newReleases.name: Agent-Native
newReleases.summary: Builder.io open-source TypeScript framework for agentic apps: agent and UI share the same actions, data and state, with MCP and A2A built in. Beta launched Oct 14.

newReleases.name: Epherem
newReleases.summary: Free security scanner for AI-built apps (Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Claude Code). Finds auth, DB, secret and package issues, with fix prompts for your coding agent.

newReleases.name: VS Code 1.142
newReleases.summary: Stable release adds agent canvases (preview), move chats across folders/worktrees, Copilot harness as default for new sessions, and enterprise agent permission controls.

newReleases.name: Navige
newReleases.summary: Sits between your AI agents and the models/tools they pay for: caching, context trimming, loop guards and smart routing to cut agent costs. Free Watchtower plan; paid plans charge a share of savings.

newReleases.name: withHuman
newReleases.summary: Open-source approval layer for AI agents: intercepts consequential tool calls and routes them through rules or a human reviewer. Hooks for coding agents and an MCP gateway. Open source free; cloud Scale plan $20/user/mo.

newReleases.name: Polylane
newReleases.summary: Production issue agent: maps your clouds, code and telemetry, catches pull requests that would break production, finds root causes and writes fixes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. Free plan; paid from $80/mo.

newReleases.name: AI Sandboxes by Buddy
newReleases.summary: Real Linux VMs for running AI-generated code and the apps it becomes, controlled via CLI, SDK, YAML or MCP, with snapshots and public endpoints.

newReleases.name: Muse Spark Open
newReleases.summary: Meta's open-weight coding and agent model: 816B total / 42B active MoE, 1M-token context, multimodal input. Weights on Hugging Face under the Muse Model License; API via OpenRouter, Groq, Together, Fireworks and others; runs on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with MLX.

newReleases.name: Figma code layers, Specs and agent GA
newReleases.summary: Figma's Build by Design launch: code-backed prototypes on the canvas (code layers, open beta on all plans), Markdown Specs for shared context (open beta, paid plans), the Figma agent now generally available, and Figma MCP updates for coding agents.

newReleases.name: Kerno 1.0
newReleases.summary: AI backend QA engineer that maps your codebase and tests full user flows, security, background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless, catching bugs inside your agent's session and again on every PR in CI. Free tier to start.

newReleases.name: GitHub agentic autofix (GA)
newReleases.summary: Assign a code scanning alert to Copilot and it explores the codebase, proposes a fix, reruns CodeQL to confirm it closes the alert, then opens a draft PR. For GitHub Code Security / Advanced Security on Enterprise Cloud.

newReleases.name: Harness by Autonomous
newReleases.summary: Open-source command center for coding agents: run Claude Code, Codex and others across all your machines side by side, from a desktop app, terminal or phone (with voice). Free download; optional $149 desk device. #2 on Product Hunt's Oct 16 daily leaderboard.

newReleases.name: Pomerado
newReleases.summary: YC-backed, open-source tool that turns any website (Google Flights, Zillow, legacy portals) into a tested API or MCP server for your agents, handling sign-in and 2FA. Free plan (100 tool calls/day); Premium $50/mo.

newReleases.name: Parallax by Conifer
newReleases.summary: Mac app (Linux daemon too) that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents in one place: a Captain splits your ask across agents, built-in code review, and auto-fallback when one subscription hits its limit. Free to start with $50 of Conifer credit on GitHub sign-up.

newReleases.name: GBrain Tools
newReleases.summary: From Garry Tan's YC-backed GBrain: connect Gmail, GitHub, Stripe and more once and use them in Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and your terminal without any AI seeing a password. Tools $19/mo per license; team workspace $199/mo.

newReleases.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
newReleases.summary: NVIDIA's open multimodal model for agents: 120B total / 12B active MoE, up to 1M-token context, text, image, document and video input, with tool use and coding. Open weights on Hugging Face; hosted via OpenRouter and NVIDIA NIM.

newReleases.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein
newReleases.summary: Black Forest Labs' 5.6B open-weights image model for text-to-image, editing and multi-reference generation (up to 10 images), with native 4K. Runs on GPUs with as little as 8GB VRAM (INT8); also in the BFL API.

newReleases.name: Lovable Growth tools
newReleases.summary: Lovable now helps you get users from the same chat you build in: a growth plan from your app and traffic, SEO and community posts, and Google, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram ads that only spend after you approve. On Free, Pro and Business plans; no extra Lovable fee beyond normal chat usage.

newReleases.name: NitroStack
newReleases.summary: Full-stack platform for MCP servers: open-source TypeScript and Python SDK and CLI, NitroStudio to test tools visually, and NitroCloud hosting with GitHub deploys and scale-to-zero. Free Hobby plan (30k requests/mo); Pro $30/org/mo. #1 on Product Hunt's Oct 17 daily leaderboard.

newReleases.name: Ultracite v8
newReleases.summary: Zero-config linter and formatter preset (Oxlint, Biome or ESLint) built to keep agent-written JS/TS consistent. v8 writes its rules once to AGENTS.md for every coding agent, and ultracite fix --claude or --codex hands leftover issues to that agent. Free and open source (MIT). On Product Hunt Oct 17.

newReleases.name: Cursor canvases and Environments API
newReleases.summary: Cursor cloud agents can now build interactive canvases you share by link, a new Environments API (beta) creates and manages agent environments in code, and environments now hold up to 300 repos and load large setups 5x faster.

newReleases.name: Step 5 Preview (open weights)
newReleases.summary: StepFun's flagship model for long-running agent and coding work: 600B total / 27B active MoE, up to 1M-token context, text and image input. Open weights on Hugging Face under the StepFun Model License 1.0, plus StepFun's API. Self-hosting needs data-center GPUs.

newReleases.name: Sphinx
newReleases.summary: Free, open-source Git hook that quizzes you on what your coding agent's diff actually does before a push goes through. Works with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode and Pi, using your agent, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible model. Show HN on Oct 18.
